scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 您攜帶的物品太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後再試。 -

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
Let's show the power of the Guillaume Army to those stinky Croixs!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
讓那些克魯瓦的臭傢伙見識一下吉約姆軍團的力量！

scripts.text: I want to join your army!
scripts.translation: 加入軍隊

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
I'm very pleased that you want to join us and fight the Croix Army, but I'm sorry: I can't send a rookie like you to die on the cruel battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
很高興你願意加入我們，對抗克魯瓦軍團。
不過，你還是個新手，我不能送你去殘酷的戰場上送死。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
I'm very pleased that you want to join us and fight the Croix Army, but I'm sorry: I can't send a rookie like you to die on the cruel battlefield.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
You seem to have just returned from the battlefield.
It's too early for you to go back. Go rest, and leave the enemies to us!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
你似乎剛從戰場回來，現在就返回還太早了。
去休息一下，把敵人交給我們！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
I've received a report informing me that an elite corps has been dispatched to the battlefield fighting the Croixs already.
Why don't you go wait for a while? I suggest you sharpen your weapons and prepare your supplies until then.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
據報告，精銳部隊已經出征，正在戰場上對抗克魯瓦軍團。
請先等一會兒，趁這段時間磨好武器、備足補給。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
An elite corps is already standing by to be dispatched to the battlefield.
Why don't you go wait for a while? I suggest you sharpen your weapons and prepare your supplies until then.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
精銳部隊已經集結，正在等待出征。
請先等一會兒，趁這段時間磨好武器、備足補給。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
You definitely seem to be ready for battle!
Go show the Croixs what fear truly means!
Today, our cry of victory shall echo all over the battlefield!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
看來你已經準備好戰鬥了！
去讓克魯瓦軍團見識什麼叫恐懼！
今天，我們勝利的吶喊將響徹戰場！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
Today, we shall be victorious!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
今天，我們將取得勝利！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
Tierra Gorge consists of two steep sides placed vertically, and has ration depots for the Guillaume and Croix Armies at the 11 and 7 o'clock directions.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
蒂拉峽谷兩側是陡峭的巖壁，吉約姆軍團和克魯瓦軍團的補給倉庫分別位於11點和7點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
The battle starts at your army's ship, and the goal is to advance and destroy your enemy's rations depot faster than they can destroy yours.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
戰鬥從己方軍船開始，目標是搶在敵人摧毀我方補給倉庫之前，摧毀敵方的補給倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
The healer of the battlefield will resurrect soldiers once every 25 seconds so that they can rejoin the battle.
The army that captures the neutral flag in the center of the battlefield will be rewarded with extra regeneration points, meaning their soldiers will resurrect more than the other side, giving them an advantage.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
戰場治療師每25秒會復活一批士兵，讓他們重返戰場。
佔領戰場中央的中立旗幟，可以獲得額外的復活點，讓更多士兵復活，從而取得優勢。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
Those two rations depots are connected to each other through short and narrow paths, but the gates are blocked with barricades.
Think and move as quickly as you can. The victory of your army relies on your contribution.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
兩個補給倉庫由狹窄的短徑相連，但入口被路障封鎖。
請迅速判斷、果斷行動，你的表現關係到整個軍團的勝敗。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
If you are ready, start by clicking the ^0000FFbattle button from the interface^000000.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
準備好後，請點選^0000FF介面上的戰鬥按鈕^000000開始。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
Please remember: when you join a battle, you will receive a token which indicates the set duration for which you cannot participate in the same type of battle.
You may check the duration by pressing the Alt+U keys.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
參加戰鬥後，你會獲得一個標記，顯示再次參加同類戰鬥所需等待的時間。
按Alt+U可以檢視。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
Please bear in mind once you cancel, ^0000FFyou may not reapply for 1 minute^000000!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
請注意，取消申請後，^0000FF1分鐘內不能重新申請^000000！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
Are you ready to battle? Then apply with the recruiter next to me!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
準備好戰鬥了嗎？
去找我旁邊的招募員報名吧！
